goal: Prioritize roles that can realistically start around Bora's near-term hiring objective and suppress known far-future starts from Bora-facing serious discovery/package work, without treating an unstated start date as a blocker or changing Qualification Truth.
acceptance_conditions: known intended start dates 0-30 days from the current operating date are the TARGETED near-term start window that Career OS should actively target for discovery and application effort
known intended start dates 31-60 days from the current operating date are an acceptable around-target window

known intended start dates more than 60 days away are suppressed from Bora-facing serious discovery and package generation unless Bora explicitly requests a future-start pipeline or explicitly overrides the timing gate for that role
an unstated or unreliably inferred start date remains UNKNOWN and is not suppressed merely because the employer omitted a start date
a near application deadline or recently posted role cannot rescue a known far-future start date
the rule is Bora-specific discovery/pursuit timing doctrine only and never changes Qualification Truth, Employer Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, authorization, or actionability
fresh chats inherit the rule through .cursor/rules/role-selection.mdc
Brattle Research Analyst July 2027 is recorded as the motivating live example and would be suppressed under this gate on 2026-09-09
no resume or cover-letter doctrine is changed
stop_conditions: implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths
implementation would treat UNKNOWN start date as a far-future start
implementation would allow posting freshness or application deadline to override a known start date beyond 60 days without Bora override
implementation would create a schema/runtime enum or alter Qualification Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, authorization, actionability, resume, or package generation
